'''The Resistor''' was a [[cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]] exclusively for [[droid]]s. As a "droid bar," it did not offer a range of drinks like those offered to organic organisms but exclusively served [[Nepenthé]].<ref name="Chapter 22" />

The staff at The Resistor gave out [[spark pad]]s to advertise the establishment.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
